description:
List the workspaces in the connected Refora organization. Call this first: every other workspace tool needs a workspace_id from here.

Use this tool when the user asks about their workspaces, projects, or brands they're monitoring -- phrases like 'what am I tracking', 'list my projects', 'show me my brands', or 'which workspaces do I have'.

Returns: workspace ID, name, primary brand domain, active prompt count, creation date, website, data_source (own_tracking, market_data or none) and a one-line summary for each workspace.

Example question: 'What workspaces do I have set up in Refora?'
name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
